script: Decision: covered. The claimant reports direct contact with a deer, which CA-AUTO-D-ANIMAL classifies as other-than-collision loss covered under the purchased coverage. The declarations establish a listed vehicle and active coverage; no material coverage gap remains, and payment is subject to the applicable limit and deductible. Next action: Approve other-than-collision coverage, assess repair costs, and apply the applicable limit and declarations deductible.
